create_MultivariateNormalDiag: create a MultivariateNormalDiag distribution with a mean vector and diagonal standard deviations
sample_MultivariateNormalDiag: sample random values from a MultivariateNormalDiag distribution with specified loc and scale_diag
compute_cdf_MultivariateNormalDiag: compute the cumulative distribution function of a MultivariateNormalDiag for given values
compute_log_cdf_MultivariateNormalDiag: compute the log cumulative distribution function of a MultivariateNormalDiag for given values
index_MultivariateNormalDiag: index into a batched MultivariateNormalDiag distribution to extract a subset by batch dimension
